title: Data Center
description: Outdoor wind and façade solar radiation analysis exploring louver configurations by orientation, depth and location.
body: Outdoor wind analysis guided building placement, while a parametric solar radiation script explored different façade louver configurations based on orientation, louver depth and geographic location — developed with Grasshopper and Autodesk Forma as part of Lombardini22's Sustainability team.
Specific analysis outputs remain confidential to the client.
